scope: Mage quest 42009, Harnessing the Arcane, in the outdoor Nexus subzone 4120.
client_evidence: The active Mage quest reached 42009 after rewarding 42006, 42007 and 42008. The user showed a slain Arcane Aberrant, a 0/1 objective and no visible Unstable Arcane Energy bar. The saved quest showed both objective counters at zero. A visible 0/1 on its own can be normal until the separate bar reaches 100.
cause: The live 211691 SpellArea entry had the same quest 42009 on both gates, with start mask 8 (Incomplete) and end mask 66 (Complete or Rewarded). SpellArea::IsFitToRequirements requires both masks to include the current status. The aura therefore could not set the Mage's maximum alternate power to 100. EffectEnergize requires a nonzero maximum before awarding power.
repair: World28 sets the matching Mage row's end mask to 8. Its existing area, Mage class, quest-state and autocast requirements determine activation on quest update or area entry and removal on completion or leaving. Retain the real Arcane Aberrant 106569 death owner credit and Breach of Arcane Energy 106566 click and timed siphon. Both cast native 152435 for 10 alternate power, and the native full-bar path issues the 104786 credit. No quest status, objective count, loot or character data is forced.
review: Reviewed local matching native spell evidence from the October 30 resource audit, the actual live SmartAI rows and the current SpellArea and progress-bar code. The parallel Priest row 207066 has the same contradictory masks and needs its own client check. Its data is outside this Mage repair. No separate automated, modeled, native or agent-owned startup tests were run during active gameplay.
deployment: Promoted after the user stopped the worldserver. Once the user left, the task-owned canonical startup applied World28, reached ready and shut down gracefully with exit 0. The live updater reports RELEASED with SQL SHA-1 A595D6DAB17DC68868603E3D9BB5AEA7F100B5A6. The live Mage masks are 8/8. Energy display, kill/siphon and quest turn-in in the client remain to be checked.
diagnostics: The task-owned startup produced no new warnings, errors, assertions or crashes, stderr was empty and DBErrors.log stayed at 1347 bytes. The separate Taunka'le Pack Kodo 26160 display-load errors occurred before this repair on spawns in areas 4037 and 4042, outside the Nexus subzone. Those entries remain in DBErrors.log. Startup output and the baseline are retained locally under .codex/aluneth-nexus-energy-20261127.
